options: The transformation of society through emerging technologies
The use, development and management of computer systems, software, networks and information
Only the marketing of digital products
The study of customer behaviour
The regulation of data privacy
questions.explanation: IT encompasses the use, development and management of computer systems, software, networks and information.

questions.stem: What is IT primarily concerned with?
options: The technology used to store, retrieve, transmit and manipulate data
Creating new business models
Enhancing customer experiences through social media
Reforming organisational culture
Designing product packaging
questions.explanation: IT is primarily concerned with the technology used to store, retrieve, transmit and manipulate data.

questions.stem: Which of the following is given as an example of what IT includes?
options: Artificial intelligence strategy
Internet of things initiatives
Hardware such as computers, servers and storage
Customer experience redesign
Business model transformation
questions.explanation: IT includes hardware (computers, servers, storage), software, networking and the management of databases and information systems.

questions.stem: How is the term Digital described relative to IT?
options: A narrower term covering only websites
A synonym for IT
An older term that IT has replaced
A broader term that extends beyond technology to the transformation of processes, businesses and society
A term that applies only to consumer devices
questions.explanation: Digital is a broader term that extends beyond technology and includes the transformation of processes, businesses and society through digital technologies.

questions.stem: Which of the following is named as an area involved in digital transformation beyond IT?
options: Local area networks
Operating systems
Server hardware
Database administration
Internet of things (IoT)
questions.explanation: Digital transformation involves not only IT but also data analytics, artificial intelligence, IoT, cloud computing and other emerging technologies.

questions.stem: What do digital initiatives aim to do?
options: Leverage technology to bring about fundamental changes in how organisations operate, interact with customers and deliver value
Reduce the number of computers an organisation owns
Replace all software with hardware
Restrict technology to the IT department
Standardise operating systems across the business
questions.explanation: Digital initiatives aim to leverage technology to fundamentally change how organisations operate, interact with customers and deliver value.

questions.stem: What is the summarised relationship between IT and Digital?
options: Digital is a subset of IT
IT is a subset of the broader digital landscape
IT and Digital are unrelated fields
Digital is a department within IT
IT is a newer term than Digital
questions.explanation: IT is a subset of the broader digital landscape and a foundational component of the digital ecosystem.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of networking within IT?
options: Applications and operating systems
Data analytics dashboards
Local area networks and wide area networks
Cloud computing strategy
Customer interaction design
questions.explanation: Networking within IT includes local area networks and wide area networks.

questions.stem: What does the digital approach integrate into various aspects of life and business?
options: Only database management systems
Only hardware upgrades
Paper-based processes
Digital technologies, to improve efficiency, create new opportunities and enhance experiences
Physical retail outlets
questions.explanation: Digital is concerned with integrating digital technologies into life and business to improve efficiency, create new opportunities and enhance experiences.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as part of IT?
options: Hardware such as servers and storage
Software such as applications and operating systems
Networking such as LANs and WANs
Management of databases and information systems
Transformation of how organisations deliver value to customers
questions.explanation: Transforming how organisations deliver value is the domain of Digital; IT covers hardware, software, networking and information systems management.
